policy.candidate_discovery: Bounded role and functional search; equivalence, strategic tradeoffs and typed zero-color-source repairs carry distinct evidence
policy.strategic_review: Separate structured call using existing configured model; same model, not independent adjudication
policy.review_gate: Exact meaningful source quotes for both cards, complete pair facts, explicit preference fit; reject missing/uncertain evidence
policy.experiments: Default three; one to three distinct isolated alternatives accepted; one reviewed replacement per assistant alternative
policy.objective: Explicit user selection; no silent opening default
policy.measurements: Matching frozen engine/policy/dependency provenance, meaningful uncertainty separation and agreeing independent validation
policy.opening_scope: Native opening-policy proxy, not real opening success or overall strength
policy.other_objectives: Require complete supported native coverage; unavailable coverage produces an unknown result
policy.source_deck: Unchanged until explicit adoption; stale source invalidates outcome labels

validation.matcher_scope: Pair matcher only; not expert-scored or full assistant quality
validation.live_model_probe: Rejected three strategic losses and accepted one disclosed tradeoff on actual Vivi deck
validation.native_positive: Separate extreme wrong-color stress fixture demonstrates scoped improved and reversed regressed paths

known_limits: Semantic review can still be wrong
No proof of overall deck upgrades or multiplayer win-rate
Native gaps prevent decisive verdicts for many real swaps
Joint multi-card packages need joint strategic review before assistant support
